verdict.rationale: Flagright documents rule instances created via the Management API as 'live entities' that run checks on transactions continuously. Its homepage also claims continuous dynamic risk scoring, automated SAR filing and AI agents for AML operations, which together amount to configurable background automation within the compliance domain. These are mostly marketing one-liners, with no documented way to define, trigger or monitor general autonomous automations. Missing for 10: documented setup of autonomous AI-agent automations, recurring schedules or triggers, any Workflow Builder automation detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
